Militants Arrested in Assam and Manipur, Arms Seized

Police in Assam have foiled a terror plot, arresting two ULFA-I militants. In a separate operation in Manipur, security forces arrested six militants and recovered a significant cache of weapons and explosives. These actions highlight ongoing security challenges in India's northeastern regions.
